newsitem.title: UK: LASMO squeezed up on Pakistan speculation.
newsitem.headline: LASMO squeezed up on Pakistan speculation.

text.p: Shares in British oil and exploration company LASMO Plc defied a faltering London market to push higher on Monday as speculation about the company's oil finds in Pakistan continued to attract buyers, dealers said.
The shares were four pence higher at 247-1/2 by 1105 GMT.
Dealers said expectations were growing that the company was poised to make an encouraging statement about its operations in Pakistan and this was boosting the stock.
"It seems to be talk about this Pakistan discovery that's helping them," one market-maker said.
Another market-maker said the shares were being pushed higher as a result of a bear squeeze, with one securities house in particular chasing the stock.
